question: Which of the following states was allocated the highest budget for highway projects in Union Budget 2021-22?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the union budget 2022-23, a total of Rs 7,134.56 crore was earmarked for taking up various railway projects in Tamil Nadu and it is the highest budget allocated for highway projects in Union Budget 2021-22.**
 
• Southern Railway was allocated Rs 7,134.56 crore for FY 2022-23 in addition to Rs 1,064.34 crore which was an extra-budgetary resource.
 
• In Kerala, Rs 9,489 crore has been allocated for 8 projects covering a length of 439 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A new scheme, Prime Minister's Development Initiative for North-East, PM- DevINE has been announced by the Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman while presenting the Union Budget 2022-23 on 01 February 2022.
 
• The** PM-DevINE** will be implemented through the North-Eastern Council.
 
• The Union Budget has allocated 1,40,367.13 cr to the Railway Ministry - *20,311 cr more than the revised figures of the previous fiscal (2021-22).
 
• It also allocated ₹15,710.44 cr to the Dedicated Freight Corridor, whose assets will be monetized by the Railways for operations and maintenance.
 
• The rail sector will also develop** "One Station One Product"**, which will leverage local produce carried on the railways.
 
• As a part of Atmanirbhar Bharat, a 2,000 km network will be brought under 'Kavach', the indigenous world-class technology for safety and capacity augmentation in 2022-23.
 
• The finance minister said 100 PM GatiShakti Cargo Terminals for multi-modal logistics facilities will be developed during the next three years.
